name: Viking 2
tagline: Second Viking: an orbiter and a lander that worked in Utopia Planitia until 1980
description: The second of NASA's two Viking spacecraft, each an orbiter carrying a lander. Viking 2 launched on 1975-09-09, entered Mars orbit on 1976-08-07 and set its lander down in Utopia Planitia on 1976-09-03, about 6,460 km from the Viking 1 lander. The lander worked until 1980-04-12 and the orbiter until 1978-07-24, when it was turned off after a propulsion-system leak.
best_known_for: Second Viking: an orbiter and a lander that worked in Utopia Planitia until 1980
